name: carbon-native-v2
description: Carbon Native V2 — third-party npm dependencies for the TypeScript tier.
//: Not a bun workspace root: no `workspaces` array and no `workspace:*` anywhere. Internal @carbon/* wiring is path aliases in ./tsconfig.base.json, so nothing is installed or symlinked for it — this is purely the flat list of third-party packages the TypeScript tier needs. Install with `bun install --cwd .config` from the workspace root, which puts node_modules HERE. Bun then resolves it through the `node_modules` junction at the workspace root, because module resolution walks UP from each importing file and would otherwise never look inside .config/. Create that junction with .tools/automation/bootstrap/link-node-modules.{ps1,sh}.
//trustedDependencies: DELIBERATELY EMPTY. This is the repository's real dependency root — `bun install --cwd .config` is the command every contributor and the devcontainer run — so it is the highest-value place in the repo for an npm install script to execute. Bun blocks dependency lifecycle scripts by default, but only against a BUILT-IN allowlist of ~366 names (`bun pm default-trusted`); declaring this field REPLACES that list instead of extending it, so `[]` is the only spelling of 'nothing runs'. Verified on 2026-08-25 against bun 1.3.10 with this exact package.json + bun.lock: `bun install --frozen-lockfile` installs all 136 packages with no lockfile drift, and vite/react/three/discord.js all import and run. Of those 136 only esbuild@0.21.5 has a postinstall that would otherwise fire (its platform binary arrives via optionalDependencies, not that script — checked, esbuild transforms fine without it); the `prepare` scripts on rollup/undici/@tweenjs/tween.js/magic-bytes.js/babel-plugin-jsx-dom-expressions only run for git or linked deps, never for registry tarballs. Add a name here ONLY with evidence the package is broken without it.
